stories.headline: OpenAI Launches Dots Autonomous Agents at DevDay 2026
stories.blurb: OpenAI unveiled Dots, new autonomous AI agents designed to execute complex workflows, alongside over 20 other developer-focused platform launches.

stories.headline: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.1 Sol for Agentic Coding
stories.blurb: OpenAI has released its GPT-6.1 Sol model, offering agentic coding and professional-grade performance at one-fifth the cost of its premium Astra model.

stories.headline: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Argon Frontier Model
stories.blurb: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon, pushing the boundaries of multimodal intelligence and reasoning capabilities.

stories.headline: DeepSeek Open-Sources TileLang to Run AI on Huawei Hardware
stories.blurb: DeepSeek released TileLang, an open-source tool designed to run high-performance AI workloads on Huawei Ascend chips as a simpler alternative to NVIDIA's CUDA.

stories.headline: Anthropic Releases Claude 5.5 Sonnet with Faster Output Speed
stories.blurb: Anthropic has upgraded Claude Sonnet to version 5.5, delivering significantly quicker response times for developers and enterprise integrations.

stories.headline: Teen Researcher Gains Admin Access to 17-Trillion-Row Microsoft Database
stories.blurb: A 16-year-old security researcher discovered a critical Microsoft vulnerability that granted full administrative access to highly sensitive backend databases holding over 17 trillion rows of data.

stories.headline: Can Sandboxing Contain Rogue AI Agents?
stories.blurb: Security experts warn that standard application sandboxing techniques are fundamentally inadequate for containing the unpredictable, multi-step actions of autonomous AI agents.

stories.headline: Leaked Video Shows Police Bypassing iPhone Inactivity Reboots
stories.blurb: A leaked video reveals that law enforcement tools like GrayKey can successfully bypass iOS's automatic inactivity reboot mechanism to access locked devices.

stories.headline: GPT-6 Astra Executes Supply-Chain Attacks in UK Safety Tests
stories.blurb: UK government researchers found that OpenAI’s advanced GPT-6 Astra model successfully simulated complex supply-chain cyberattacks, raising significant safety concerns.

stories.headline: Shopify Deserts React Native for Fully Native Mobile Apps
stories.blurb: In a major architectural pivot, Shopify has shifted away from React Native to adopt fully native mobile development to optimize performance and developer velocity.

stories.headline: Why Git 3.0's Shift to SHA-256 May Be a Costly Move
stories.blurb: Git Butler outlines why transitioning to SHA-256 as the default hashing algorithm in Git 3.0 could introduce massive backward compatibility issues and engineering friction.

stories.headline: Reddit Eliminates RSS Feeds and Public APIs to Block AI Scraping
stories.blurb: Reddit is removing its long-standing RSS feeds and terminating public API access in an aggressive effort to prevent AI models from scraping its platform for training data.

stories.headline: Bot Traffic Officially Surpasses Humans on the Web
stories.blurb: Cloudflare data reveals that automated bot and AI agent traffic has officially eclipsed human-generated traffic online, ushering in an era of the 'agentic web.'
